articles.title: Crypto firms face July 1 EU cutoff as MiCA grace period ends
articles.snippet: The ESMA says crypto companies without MiCA authorization must stop serving EU clients from July 1, even if their license applications remain under review.

articles.title: UK Regulator Warns Soccer Clubs Over Unauthorized Crypto Sponsorship Deals
articles.snippet: The FCA has warned Premier League clubs that partnerships with unlicensed crypto firms could expose fans to unregulated trading platforms.
